تبتلعوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَلِعُوا (tabtaliʕū) /tab.ta.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# تُبْتَلَعُوا (tubtalaʕū) /tub.ta.la.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
